label: Move up the tab list
description: Keybind to select the previous (upward) tab. Combine modifiers (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta/Cmd, or Accel) with a key using +. Examples: Ctrl+Shift+ArrowUp, Alt+K, Accel+PageUp.

label: Move down the tab list
description: Keybind to select the next (downward) tab. Combine modifiers (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta/Cmd, or Accel) with a key using +. Examples: Ctrl+Shift+ArrowDown, Alt+J, Accel+PageDown.

label: Show debug toast on keypress
description: Display an on-screen toast and log to the console when shortcuts load and fire.
